name: SoloRoadTripLandmarkIdentification

custom.system_prompt: Life-first solo long drive with Sofia, a freelance journalist, driving alone to report on a story. She thinks aloud about the piece she's working on, makes a one-sided hands-free phone call to her partner (we only hear her side), notices a distant landmark early and lets it go, and much later asks Sigma once to identify it after it reappears.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Interior of a car driven solo on a long daytime drive: steady road noise, quiet music, occasional phone speaker audio, changing road surfaces

initial_prompt: Generate a solo long-drive monologue for Sofia, a freelance journalist driving alone to report on a story. She thinks aloud about the article she's working on, half-forming sentences and arguments with herself. Partway through, she makes a hands-free phone call to her partner — we only hear her side of the conversation, with natural pauses implying his responses — catching up and mentioning the drive. Early on she notices a distant landmark and speculates about it alone, briefly, then drops it. Much later, after the landmark reappears from a different angle, she finally asks Sigma to identify it. Sigma answers in one short sentence and she reacts briefly before returning to her own thoughts.

user1.name: Sofia
user1.tts_prompt: Passionate and articulate, thinking aloud, occasional code-switching into Spanish

variations.context: A freelance journalist is a couple of hours into a solo drive to report on a story. She is not actively navigating.

setting.mood: Focused, occasionally intense about work, warm when talking to her partner, relaxed between bursts of thought.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Self-dialogue interspersed with one real phone call. Sigma is available through the car system but not treated as a participant.
setting.background: She has a deadline for the piece she's working on and time alone to think it through. Her partner is at home.
setting.conversation_style: Stream-of-consciousness thinking aloud, half-formed arguments, one-sided phone dialogue with implied pauses, and occasional direct requests to Sigma when needed.

scenario_template.topic: Sofia is already well into the drive, picking up a thought she'd started forming before she left.
scenario_template.note: Do not begin with directions or ETA.

scenario_template.topic: She thinks aloud about the article she's working on, testing a few different angles and arguing with herself about which one is strongest.
scenario_template.mood: Intense, focused, occasionally frustrated with her own drafting
scenario_template.note: Make this phase substantial and independent of the drive itself.

scenario_template.topic: She notices a distant tower or ridge, wonders aloud what it is, offers herself an uncertain guess, and moves on.
scenario_template.note: This is the first non-trigger. Brief speculation alone, no resolution, then dropped.

scenario_template.topic: She calls her partner hands-free. We hear only her side — catching up, mentioning the drive and the deadline, with natural pauses implying his responses.
scenario_template.note: One-sided dialogue only. Include at least one pause where she's clearly listening to him.

scenario_template.topic: After the call ends, a quieter stretch with just music and road noise before her thoughts pick back up.
The same landmark comes back into view from a different angle, closer this time, reviving her curiosity now that she has a moment.
scenario_template.note: She makes one more attempt to guess before deciding to just ask.

scenario_template.topic: Sofia explicitly asks Sigma to identify the landmark.
scenario_template.note: Exactly one request and one response. Sigma answers in one sentence and does not continue.

scenario_template.topic: She reacts briefly to herself — mild satisfaction or amusement at her earlier guess — then returns to thinking about the article.
scenario_template.note: Sigma is not addressed again. The scenario ends mid-drive, mid-thought.

user1.name: Sofia
user1.role: Solo driver, freelance journalist. Thinks aloud about her work, makes one real phone call, and eventually asks Sigma one factual question about a landmark.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient in-car assistant. Responds exactly once, only when explicitly addressed about the landmark. Gives one concise sentence and does not continue.

conversation_structure: The drive is a setting for thinking aloud and one phone call, not a navigation task.
At least 60% of turns should concern Sofia's work, thoughts, or the phone call, independent of the landmark.
The first landmark notice must not trigger Sigma.
The phone call is one-sided — only Sofia's turns are generated, with natural pauses implying the other side.
The landmark question returns only after the phone call and a quiet stretch.
The Sigma interaction occurs late and occupies exactly two turns.
Sofia's thinking continues normally after the answer.
assistant_behavior: Sigma handles exactly one explicit factual request — identifying the landmark.
Sigma responds in one sentence, preferably fewer than fifteen words.
Sigma does not offer navigation, recommendations, or additional facts.
Sigma does not respond to the earlier speculative guess or to any part of the phone call.
Sigma remains silent after its single response.
